answer: Rotation is entered in the voyage index and the echo audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the dune beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 322 keys live and online for the whole period, which means the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
